Open positions, application details, and what it is like to work in the group are maintained on the lab site, so there is one current version rather than two.

::: {.callout appearance="simple"}
**[Current openings at lamalab.org →](https://lamalab.org/)**
:::

If nothing listed fits and you think you should still be here, write to me. I read speculative applications, and the ones that work usually lead with a question you want to answer rather than a technique you know.

For students outside the group, there is an open [mentoring programme](https://lamalab.org/mentoring/).
